name: LED bit-map diagnostic
description: Diagnostic only. Lights low-range bits (0, 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24) in the SPI output buffer 0x20001E74 immediately before shift-out. Report which controls/keys light and their order. Flash alone (untick Polyphony v1.1). Not for musical use.

patches.note: force all key bits in the output buffer before SPI shift-out
